_comment: Shape source: FRED/ALFRED vintage view of fred/series/observations (real-time window + vintage_dates params, https://alfred.stlouisfed.org/help/api) — rows here use the compact {date, value, vintage} shape; the live ALFRED API instead tags each revision row with realtime_start/realtime_end and the adapter maps realtime_start to the vintage in vintage mode. synthetic; verify against live API before first production collection run.
